adjudication.rationale: In AddGuestsDialog.tsx, the mutation onSuccess calls `utils.viewer.bookings.invalidate();`, which (per tRPC react-query utils semantics) invalidates the whole `viewer.bookings` router scope rather than a specific query key. This can cause refetching of all active `viewer.bookings.*` queries, potentially including the bookings list and other heavier queries, even though only data related to the single updated booking needs refreshing. This is a performance/scope concern grounded in the diff, not a correctness defect.
